Callout.Name: Terrorist Attack
Callout.Message: Attack in progress, multiple callers, shots reported.
Callout.Advisory: Several armed, casualties reported, area not secured.

Script.Line: It is still going on. Multiple callers and every one of them saying shots.
I need everything you have and I need it now.
Do not go in on your own. Do you hear me, do not go in on your own.

Lines.Approach: Multiple callers, shots, and casualties. Nobody has secured anything yet - go in carefully.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
